summary: Hand-written PCFG compiled to a deterministic token automaton (2292 states, alive-mask + position + PWL-log emission) reaches 0.7022 dev bpc on the first evaluation.
Document end follows a length rule (~150 chars); gating <eos> odds on step lowered after-period cost from 0.815 to 0.033 bpc; with depth-dependent modifiers total went 0.7022 -> 0.6824.
Re-estimating structural rates by reading 35 docs (adj .35, PP/RC by depth, Vi .45, adv .27, and .21) gave 0.6806 bpc, top1 0.8093; word starts carry 69% of bits.
Remaining gains are mostly in the grammar's inherent word-choice entropy; possible small gains from per-document rate adaptation or noun reuse (my tallies show weak evidence).
